name.description: Unique label for this node in the tree, at least within its parent.

width.description: Width of this node in [0..1] relative to its parent width.

attrs.description: Attributes to be displayed with this node.

end.description: Ending time of the action (if complete).

isRoot.description: True if this represents a root action.

title:
Representation of an action call history. The {@link Nameable name} is the logical action (_type_ `.` _method_).
The {@link Identifiable id} is the action id.

The width should be based on one of the standard action stats, typically `time`. Possible stats are:
  - time: total execution time
  - io: total database time
  - sql: RDBMS time
  - kv: key/value store time
See {@link LogActionStat}. These should also appear in the {@link StackTree#attrs attrs map} for presentation in
the visualization.
name: ActionStackTree
